area: Submission attachments, library, review cards, worklist, photo evidence page

heuristicIssues.issue: Search, status counts and sort run only over the rows already loaded (50 per page); a reviewer searching for an older record gets 'No submissions match these filters' and nothing tells them the search stopped at the loaded page.
heuristicIssues.evidence: web/src/features/submissions/SubmissionsWorklistPage.tsx:12 (PAGE_SIZE 50), :59 (/submissions/page?limit=50), :128-140 (client-side filter), :192 (placeholder promises ID/district/county/route/post mile/status/creator), :225 (filtered empty state has no 'load more' path)
heuristicIssues.recommendation: Send query/status to the API (or auto-call loadOlder while has_more and the filtered result is empty), and change the filtered-empty state to offer 'Search older submissions'. Until then, label the input 'Search loaded rows' and put the loaded count in the placeholder.

heuristicIssues.issue: Summary cards read as global KPIs ('Submitted 3 - Awaiting review') but are computed from the loaded page only; after 'Load older submissions' the numbers change, which is confusing and can hide a review backlog.
heuristicIssues.evidence: SubmissionsWorklistPage.tsx:120-126 (counts from items), :156-162 (card labels/hints), :252 (Load older grows items)
heuristicIssues.recommendation: Have the page endpoint return per-status totals and drive the cards from them; if that is not possible, retitle the group 'Loaded rows by status' and drop the KPI-style hints.

heuristicIssues.issue: Three vocabularies for one status: the card says 'Returned', the select and badge say 'REJECTED', and the search matches only the raw code, so typing 'returned' (the word on the card) yields no rows.
heuristicIssues.evidence: SubmissionsWorklistPage.tsx:160 ('Returned'), :198 (select renders raw key), :134 (search matches raw status), web/src/features/submissions/SubmissionDetailPrimitives.tsx:15 (badge prints raw status)
heuristicIssues.recommendation: Introduce one statusLabel(status) map (DRAFT->Draft, SUBMITTED->Submitted, APPROVED->Approved, REJECTED->Returned) used by badge, select, delete dialog, summary card and the search matcher.

heuristicIssues.heuristic: Match between system and the real world
heuristicIssues.issue: Reporter column shows 'User #12'; coordinators think in names, and the only extra information is a hover title repeating the id.
heuristicIssues.evidence: SubmissionsWorklistPage.tsx:234; same pattern in SubmissionDeleteDialog.tsx:46, SubmissionReviewerSupport.tsx:52, SubmissionPhotoEvidencePanel.tsx:161
heuristicIssues.recommendation: Expose created_by display name/email on the page endpoint (or a /users lookup cache) and render 'J. Campos' with the id only in the tooltip.

heuristicIssues.issue: The '...' row menu cannot be dismissed with Escape or an outside click, has no role=menu, and is absolutely positioned inside the overflow-x-auto table wrapper so on the last rows it is clipped or scrolls inside the table box.
heuristicIssues.evidence: SubmissionsWorklistPage.tsx:49 (menuOpenId only toggled), :219 (overflow-x-auto wrapper), :240 (absolute right-0 top-full z-50 menu); compare the tile menu which handles both, SubmissionAttachmentTiles.tsx:208-222
heuristicIssues.recommendation: Reuse one Menu component (portal-rendered, Escape + outside-click + arrow keys) for both the row menu and the tile Open menu; or replace the single-item menu with an inline 'Delete' icon button.

heuristicIssues.issue: Error and loading messages are plain divs without role=alert/aria-live and the table has no caption or aria-label; a screen-reader user is not told the list failed, refreshed, or that Refresh discarded the older pages they loaded.
heuristicIssues.evidence: SubmissionsWorklistPage.tsx:217 (error div), :224 (loading row), :220 (table without caption), :55-63 (loadFirstPage replaces items and resets cursor)
heuristicIssues.recommendation: Add role=alert to the error banner, aria-live=polite on the footer 'Showing X of Y', a <caption class='sr-only'>, and show 'Updated 14:32' next to Refresh.

heuristicIssues.issue: Two controls filter by the same status (five clickable cards and a Status select) and the sort option 'Submitted first' is redundant once the Submitted card is active.
heuristicIssues.evidence: SubmissionsWorklistPage.tsx:169-186 (cards set status), :194-200 (select sets status), :205 (SUBMITTED_FIRST)
heuristicIssues.recommendation: Keep the cards as the status filter, drop the select, and turn the Sort into a segmented 'Newest / Oldest' control.

heuristicIssues.heuristic: Match between system and the real world
heuristicIssues.issue: 'This action cannot be undone from the Web UI' implies the mobile app or backend can undo it; the summary also shows the raw status code and 'User #id'.
heuristicIssues.evidence: web/src/features/submissions/SubmissionDeleteDialog.tsx:58, :45-46
heuristicIssues.recommendation: Change to 'This permanently deletes the record and its attachments. It cannot be undone.' and use the shared status label and user name.

heuristicIssues.issue: Close affordance is a text glyph '×' while the section-attachments dialog uses a lucide X icon button; the worklist uses text '•••' and the photo page a text '←' beside lucide ArrowLeft in the viewer.
heuristicIssues.evidence: SubmissionDeleteDialog.tsx:39 vs SubmissionSectionAttachmentsDialog.tsx:48-50; SubmissionsWorklistPage.tsx:240; SubmissionPhotoEvidencePage.tsx:52 vs SubmissionAttachmentTiles.tsx:326
heuristicIssues.recommendation: Standardise on lucide icons (X, MoreHorizontal, ArrowLeft) inside one IconButton primitive with a 40px hit area.

heuristicIssues.heuristic: Help users recognise, diagnose and recover from errors
heuristicIssues.issue: PDF 'Open here' renders a bare iframe with no load-error fallback; the 'Preview unavailable' path is wired only to img and video. On iOS/iPadOS the iframe shows a single non-scrollable page, so a multi-page PDF is a dead end.
heuristicIssues.evidence: SubmissionAttachmentTiles.tsx:316-317 (iframe, no onError) vs :313-315 (img/video onError -> setFailed), :350-361 (UnavailablePreview only reachable via failed flag or non-previewable media)
heuristicIssues.recommendation: Render PDFs through pdf.js (or <object> with a fallback child) and on touch/iOS default 'Open here' for PDFs to the UnavailablePreview card with 'Open in a new tab'.

heuristicIssues.issue: Choosing 'Open here' replaces the whole grid with one file and there is no next/previous; reviewing 15 photos means 15 round trips through 'Back to files'. The section-attachments dialog inherits the same behaviour.
heuristicIssues.evidence: SubmissionAttachmentTiles.tsx:374 (single viewer state), :389-390 (viewer replaces grid), :322-346 (viewer has only Back/New tab/Download)
heuristicIssues.recommendation: Add previous/next (arrow keys, swipe) over the currently filtered items and keep a thumbnail strip under the viewer; consider a lightbox overlay instead of replacing the grid so scroll position is preserved.

heuristicIssues.issue: 'Download' silently falls back to opening the file in a new tab when the cross-origin fetch fails (likely for MinIO presigned URLs without CORS), so the user who asked for a download gets an unexpected navigation and no explanation; 'Saving…' then simply disappears.
heuristicIssues.evidence: SubmissionAttachmentTiles.tsx:85-103 (catch -> openAttachmentInNewTab), :272-276 (button label)
heuristicIssues.recommendation: Prefer a server-issued response-content-disposition=attachment presigned URL and use a plain <a download href>; if the fallback must stay, surface 'Your browser opened the file in a new tab; use Save As to download.'

heuristicIssues.issue: The only error surface is a banner at the top of the grid, so a failed Open/Download on a tile in row 6 reports itself off-screen; there is also no skeleton while every photo tile fires its own download-url request on mount.
heuristicIssues.evidence: SubmissionAttachmentTiles.tsx:383-388 (banner before grid), :402 (tile onError -> setError), :204-206 (requestPreview per tile), :252-262 (glyph shown while URL pending)
heuristicIssues.recommendation: Show the error inline on the tile (and as a toast), and render a shimmer placeholder while previewUrl is null and a request is pending; batch preview URLs via the photo-map seed for all photos.

heuristicIssues.issue: Filter pills use role=tablist/tab with no tabpanel or arrow-key handling, and the Open menu uses role=menu/menuitem with no arrow-key navigation or focus move; assistive tech announces widgets that do not behave like the pattern.
heuristicIssues.evidence: SubmissionLibrary.tsx:37-56 (role=tablist/tab, aria-selected); SubmissionAttachmentTiles.tsx:164-176 (role=menu, click only), :208-222 (only Escape/outside click)
heuristicIssues.recommendation: Use role=group with aria-pressed buttons for the filters; give the menu roving focus (ArrowUp/Down, Home/End, focus first item on open, return focus on close).

heuristicIssues.issue: Each tile prints the media type up to three times (glyph label, top-left badge, type label under the name) plus an internal '#id'; the header count label repeats the counts already on the filter pills.
heuristicIssues.evidence: SubmissionAttachmentTiles.tsx:110 (glyph text), :116-120 (badge), :283 (attachmentTypeLabel), :287 (#id); SubmissionLibrary.tsx:34 vs :54
heuristicIssues.recommendation: Keep the badge only when there is no thumbnail (i.e. inside the glyph), drop the type text and '#id' from the foot, and replace the header count with the section chip breakdown or nothing.

heuristicIssues.heuristic: Match between system and the real world
heuristicIssues.issue: The viewer fallback shows the raw MIME type ('application/octet-stream · 2.1 MB') and 'Open in a new window' relies on a popup feature string that mobile browsers ignore.
heuristicIssues.evidence: SubmissionAttachmentTiles.tsx:355, :82
heuristicIssues.recommendation: Show the humanised type label from attachmentTypeLabel and hide the 'new window' item on hover:none / narrow viewports.

heuristicIssues.issue: The 22px-tall 'Open attachments (n)' button sits inside the GISA card header that starts a drag on mousedown (per the inventory, SubmissionDetailPage.tsx:95-105); a slightly-off press can begin a card drag instead of opening the dialog, and the target is far below touch minimums.
heuristicIssues.evidence: SubmissionSectionAttachmentsDialog.tsx:11-19 (px-2 py-1 text-[11px]); drag handle behaviour not in the audited file set
heuristicIssues.recommendation: Give the button min-h-9, stopPropagation on pointerdown, and on touch devices render it as a 40px icon+count pill outside the drag handle.

heuristicIssues.issue: Initial focus lands on the Close button (first focusable) rather than the first tile, and the description repeats the count already on the trigger button.
heuristicIssues.evidence: web/src/ui/ModalDialog.tsx:49-54 (first focusable), SubmissionSectionAttachmentsDialog.tsx:46-50
heuristicIssues.recommendation: Add data-dialog-initial-focus to the first tile's Open button (or the dialog heading with tabIndex=-1) and shorten the description to 'Tagged to this section by the field form.'

heuristicIssues.issue: The Reviewer Note has no save button, no unsaved indicator and no draft persistence; the only cue that it is stored with Approve/Return is a subtitle, so a reviewer who types a note and navigates away (or refreshes) loses it silently.
heuristicIssues.evidence: SubmissionReviewerSupport.tsx:24 (subtitle), :25-35 (controlled textarea, no save affordance)
heuristicIssues.recommendation: Persist the draft note locally per submission id, show 'Unsaved - recorded when you approve or return' with a character count, and add a beforeunload / route-leave guard when the note is dirty.

heuristicIssues.heuristic: Match between system and the real world
heuristicIssues.issue: Summary rows render values via String(value), so Created/Updated/Submitted/Reviewed appear as raw ISO strings and Status as the raw enum, unlike every other surface; workflow events repeat the raw event code ('Event SUBMIT') under the human label with 'Actor user #id'.
heuristicIssues.evidence: SubmissionDetailPrimitives.tsx:24 (String(value)); SubmissionReviewerSupport.tsx:50-53
heuristicIssues.recommendation: Give SubmissionDetailRow a formatter prop (date, status, user) and drop the 'Event CODE' line, keeping the code only in a title attribute.

heuristicIssues.issue: 'Grant read access' and 'Revoke access' are visually identical neutral buttons and Revoke fires immediately with no confirmation or undo.
heuristicIssues.evidence: SubmissionAccessSharing.tsx:63-70 (grant), :91-98 (revoke, same classes, onRevoke direct)
heuristicIssues.recommendation: Style Revoke as a quiet destructive button (text-[var(--bad)]) and either confirm inline ('Revoke for Jane? Yes / Cancel') or show a 5-second undo toast.

heuristicIssues.issue: Card titles are styled divs, not headings, so the four review cards are invisible to heading navigation while the library uses an h2; compatibility aliases S/Section remain exported with an ignored 'open' prop.
heuristicIssues.evidence: SubmissionDetailPrimitives.tsx:53 (div title) vs SubmissionLibrary.tsx:33 (h2); SubmissionDetailPrimitives.tsx:68-79
heuristicIssues.recommendation: Render the title as <h2> (accept a 'level' prop) and delete the unused aliases.

heuristicIssues.issue: A page about mapped telemetry shows no map: coordinates and headings are printed as numbers, so a reviewer must remember them and flip back to the detail page's map to relate a photo to its location.
heuristicIssues.evidence: SubmissionPhotoEvidencePanel.tsx:111-115 (reference coordinates as text), :149-150 (Effective Location / Camera Heading as text)
heuristicIssues.recommendation: Embed a compact map (reference point + photo pins with heading wedges) above the cards, and highlight the pin when a card is hovered/focused; or fold this page into the detail page's map panel.

heuristicIssues.heuristic: Help users recognise, diagnose and recover from errors
heuristicIssues.issue: Images and 'Open original' use the raw presigned download_url from the initial fetch with no refresh; after ~15 minutes the fails and the page shows the misleading 'Preview unavailable in this browser', and 'Open original' 403s.
heuristicIssues.evidence: SubmissionPhotoEvidencePanel.tsx:133 (img src=download_url), :135 (fallback copy), :143 (anchor href=download_url); SubmissionAttachmentTiles.tsx:16 (900 s TTL noted)
heuristicIssues.recommendation: Route both through useAttachmentUrlResolver (seeded from the photo-map) and on image error re-resolve once before showing a fallback that says 'Link expired - Refresh evidence'.

heuristicIssues.issue: The page duplicates the detail page's Submission library (same photos, same URLs) with a different card design, a different timestamp format (with seconds), a different 'Preview unavailable' fallback and no filter, so there are two ways to look at the same photos.
heuristicIssues.evidence: SubmissionPhotoEvidencePanel.tsx:6-13 (own formatter), :123-167 (own card) vs SubmissionAttachmentTiles.tsx:183-292; SubmissionPhotoEvidencePanel.tsx:135 vs SubmissionAttachmentTiles.tsx:350-361
heuristicIssues.recommendation: Make photo evidence a mode of the library: reuse AttachmentTile with a telemetry footer (Mapped/Heading badges) and put the per-photo telemetry in the inline viewer's side panel.

heuristicIssues.heuristic: Match between system and the real world
heuristicIssues.issue: Section is printed as the raw key ('Section: highway_status') while the library maps the same key to 'Highway Status'; MIME type and 'Attachment #id' are exposed; and three different words are used for absent values in one card ('Not recorded', 'Not mapped', 'Not usable').
heuristicIssues.evidence: SubmissionPhotoEvidencePanel.tsx:142 (section_key raw, Attachment #), :148 (MIME Type), :147-152 vs submissionAttachmentModel.ts:74-78 (sectionLabel)
heuristicIssues.recommendation: Call sectionLabel(section_key), drop MIME and Attachment # from the visible card, and use one absent-value phrase ('Not recorded').

heuristicIssues.issue: Telemetry correction history shows only Yes/No flags and 'User #id'; the override coordinates and heading returned by the API are never displayed, so the reviewer cannot see what was actually changed.
heuristicIssues.evidence: SubmissionPhotoEvidencePanel.tsx:155-165; photoEvidenceApi.ts:7-8 (location_override, heading_override_deg available)
heuristicIssues.recommendation: Show 'Location: 34.0521, -118.2437 -> 34.0525, -118.2440' and 'Heading: 120° -> 95°' with the corrector's name and date.

heuristicIssues.issue: 'Linked incident #42' is plain text although an incident route exists, and there is no breadcrumb (Submissions > #id > Photo evidence); the only way back is the '← Back to submission' link.
heuristicIssues.evidence: SubmissionPhotoEvidencePanel.tsx:109; SubmissionPhotoEvidencePage.tsx:50-54
heuristicIssues.recommendation: Render the incident as a Link to /incidents/:id and add an AppShell breadcrumb slot used by both the detail and evidence pages.

heuristicIssues.heuristic: Help users recognise, diagnose and recover from errors
heuristicIssues.issue: An unknown or forbidden submission id silently fails the title fetch (catch -> null) so the page reads 'Photo Evidence — Submission #999' with an error banner from the photo-map call; the panel header and purpose sentence also repeat the H1 directly above.
heuristicIssues.evidence: SubmissionPhotoEvidencePage.tsx:22-28, :36; SubmissionPhotoEvidencePanel.tsx:78-79
heuristicIssues.recommendation: Surface the 404/403 as a page-level empty state ('Submission not found or not shared with you') and remove the duplicated panel header.

heuristicIssues.issue: Refresh gives no success feedback, loading/error messages have no role=status/alert, and the summary card and error banner markup are copy-pasted from the worklist (three duplicate error banners across the area, none announced).
heuristicIssues.evidence: SubmissionPhotoEvidencePanel.tsx:71, :81-86, :97-102 vs SubmissionsWorklistPage.tsx:173-184, :217; SubmissionAttachmentTiles.tsx:384
heuristicIssues.recommendation: Extract StatCard and ErrorBanner (role=alert) primitives and show 'Updated just now' after a successful refresh.

responsiveIssues.issue: The table is a fixed 1200px (colgroup 5+20+9+9+12+12+8 rem) inside overflow-x-auto; at 375px the user sees the ID column and a slice of the descriptor, and Status, Submitted and the primary Review action are ~800px to the right.
responsiveIssues.evidence: SubmissionsWorklistPage.tsx:219 (overflow-x-auto), :220 (table-fixed), :221 (colgroup widths), :239 (Review link in last column)
responsiveIssues.fix: Below md render a card list (descriptor as title, status badge + submitted date as meta, Review/Open as a full-width 44px button); at md-lg drop the Reporter and Created columns and let the table be w-full without the colgroup.

responsiveIssues.issue: At 768-1024px the 1200px table still overflows (content width ~680-940px) so the Action column is off-screen on iPad portrait, and the filter grid's fixed 260+220+220px columns exceed the ~680px available at md so the Sort select is clipped until ~810px.
responsiveIssues.fix: Use md:grid-cols-[minmax(0,1fr)_minmax(140px,180px)_minmax(140px,180px)] (or lg: for the three-column layout), and make the Action column sticky right (position: sticky; right: 0) with a panel background on md-lg.

responsiveIssues.issue: Summary cards fall to 2 columns so the fifth (Draft) sits alone on a third row, taking ~260px of vertical space before the list.
responsiveIssues.fix: Render the cards as a horizontally scrolling chip row (flex overflow-x-auto snap-x) below lg, or grid-cols-3 with 'Loaded' removed.

responsiveIssues.issue: The '...' menu is absolutely positioned inside the overflow-x-auto wrapper (overflow-x:auto forces overflow-y:auto), so on the last visible row the menu is clipped or triggers an inner scrollbar; touch targets for '...', Review/Open and Clear filters are ~32px.
responsiveIssues.fix: Render the menu in a portal anchored to the button, and give row controls min-h-10 (40px) with px-3; on touch show 'Delete' as a swipe/long-press or a visible icon button in the card layout.

responsiveIssues.issue: Raw timestamps and the creator id exist only in hover title attributes, which are unreachable on touch.
responsiveIssues.fix: Show the formatted date visibly and drop the titles; expose the creator name inline once available.

responsiveIssues.issue: Fits at 375px (panel ~343px), but the '×' close is a ~32px text button and the title row keeps the button beside a text-xl heading so long descriptors wrap under it.
responsiveIssues.fix: Use a 40px IconButton with lucide X and let the header be a grid-cols-[1fr_auto].

responsiveIssues.issue: Header title + four counted filter pills wrap into ~3 rows; the overlay Open/Download buttons are ~24px tall and, on hover:none devices, are permanently drawn over the bottom strip of every thumbnail.
responsiveIssues.evidence: SubmissionLibrary.tsx:27-58 (flex-wrap header, px-2.5 py-1 pills); SubmissionAttachmentTiles.tsx:267-278 (absolute bottom-2 overlay, px-2 py-1 text-xs); web/src/index.css:138-142 (hover:none -> always visible)
responsiveIssues.fix: Put the filter row on its own line below the header as a full-width segmented control with 40px targets; under @media (hover:none) move the actions out of the image area into a 40px row beneath the thumbnail instead of an overlay.

responsiveIssues.issue: Full file name and section label are only exposed via title tooltips; section chip is capped at max-w-[60%] and truncates on 200-220px tiles ('Pavement / Ground Status').
responsiveIssues.fix: Move the section chip to the tile footer on its own line (full width, no cap) and allow the file name to wrap to two lines with line-clamp-2.

responsiveIssues.issue: PDF 'Open here' is an iframe h-[70vh]; iOS Safari renders only the first page with no scrolling and the 'Preview unavailable' fallback never appears for PDFs.
responsiveIssues.fix: On touch/iOS (hover:none or navigator.maxTouchPoints>0) route PDF 'Open here' to the UnavailablePreview card with 'Open in a new tab'; on desktop use pdf.js or <object> with a fallback child.

responsiveIssues.issue: The Open menu (min-w-48 = 192px, left-0, bottom-full) sits inside an image container and article that are both overflow-hidden; at the 200px minimum tile width the menu is flush with/clipped by the right edge and on short tiles it is clipped at the top.
responsiveIssues.evidence: SubmissionAttachmentTiles.tsx:164 (absolute bottom-full left-0 min-w-48), :248 (article overflow-hidden), :251 (image div overflow-hidden)
responsiveIssues.fix: Render the menu through a portal positioned with the button's bounding rect (flip up/down and align right when near the edge), or replace the 3-way menu with a single 'Open' (inline viewer) and move new-tab/new-window into the viewer toolbar.

responsiveIssues.issue: The modal is a centred max-w-5xl / max-h-[88vh] panel with overlay p-4, so on a phone it is a 343px-wide box with the tile grid scrolling inside it while the page behind is locked; the inline viewer's 70vh media inside the 88vh body forces a nested scroll to reach 'Back to files'.
responsiveIssues.fix: Below sm render the dialog as a full-screen sheet (inset-0, rounded-none, sticky header) and size viewer media with flex-1 min-h-0 relative to the body instead of 70vh.

responsiveIssues.issue: 'Open attachments (n)' is a text-[11px] px-2 py-1 (~22px) button inside a card header that also acts as the drag handle.
responsiveIssues.fix: min-h-9 and px-2.5 on all sizes; on hover:none render as a 40px paperclip icon button with a count badge.

responsiveIssues.issue: Summary rows use a fixed 1/3 label column (grid-cols-3), leaving ~190px for values, so raw ISO timestamps like 2026-09-04T18:22:11.123456+00:00 wrap mid-token.
responsiveIssues.fix: grid-cols-1 sm:grid-cols-3 (label above value below sm) and format timestamps before rendering.

responsiveIssues.issue: The card grid needs 420px per column so it stays single-column at 768px portrait and at 1024px landscape whenever the sidebar is expanded; Access Sharing ends up far below the Reviewer Note.
responsiveIssues.fix: Lower the minimum to 340px and order the cards Reviewer Note, Workflow History, Summary, Access Sharing so the reviewer's input comes first.

responsiveIssues.issue: Grant/Revoke rows wrap the ~28px button under the name/email and the two buttons are indistinguishable.
responsiveIssues.fix: min-h-10 buttons, w-full when wrapped (flex-col sm:flex-row), and destructive styling for Revoke.

responsiveIssues.issue: Each card has a min-h-72 (288px) image well with object-contain, so a landscape photo at ~300px width renders ~225px tall letterboxed in grey, while portrait photos reach 544px; with a 6-item single-column definition list each card is 900px+ tall.
responsiveIssues.fix: Use aspect-[4/3] with object-cover thumbnails that open the inline viewer, and collapse Location Source / Altitude / MIME into a 'Details' disclosure so the visible card is image + badges + captured + location + heading.

responsiveIssues.issue: The photo grid stays single-column until xl (1280px), so a 1024px iPad landscape shows one full-width card per screen for 20+ photos.
responsiveIssues.fix: md:grid-cols-2 xl:grid-cols-3 with the compact card above, or reuse the library's auto-fill minmax(220px,1fr) grid.

responsiveIssues.issue: The evidence-context block is text-right inside a flex-wrap row; when it wraps under the incident line the coordinates are right-aligned while the label above is left-aligned.
responsiveIssues.fix: Replace with a two-column dl (grid-cols-1 sm:grid-cols-2) and drop text-right.

responsiveIssues.issue: Images load straight from presigned URLs that expire after 900 s; a page left open on any device shows broken previews with a misleading message until Refresh.
responsiveIssues.fix: Share useAttachmentUrlResolver from SubmissionAttachmentTiles.tsx:24 and re-resolve on img error.

structuralChanges: Worklist: move search/status/sort to the API (/submissions/page?q=&status=&sort=) with true per-status totals, and replace the fixed 1200px table with a responsive list: card rows below md (descriptor, status badge, submitted-ago, Review button), a 5-column table without Reporter/Created at md-lg, full table at xl; sticky right action column.

Merge the photo evidence page into the detail page: make 'Photo evidence' a filter/mode of the Submission library that overlays telemetry badges on the same AttachmentTile, and move the per-photo telemetry (location, heading, accuracy, correction history) into the inline viewer's side panel alongside a small map with the photo pin and heading wedge. Keep /submissions/:id/photo-evidence as a redirect to /submissions/:id#library?filter=photos.

Replace the grid-replacing inline viewer with a lightbox that supports previous/next (arrow keys, swipe), a thumbnail strip, and a metadata drawer; reuse it from the library, the section-attachments dialog and the evidence mode so there is one viewer.

Reorder and re-tier the review context: Reviewer Note first with explicit save state and route-leave guard, Workflow History second, Summary collapsed into a meta strip under the detail header, Access Sharing as a 'Share' header action opening a dialog only for can_manage_permissions users; lower the card grid minimum to 340px so tablets get two columns.

Introduce shared primitives used across the area: StatCard/filter chip (worklist + evidence summaries), ErrorBanner (role=alert), IconButton (40px, lucide), Menu (portal, keyboard, Escape/outside click) and a status/user/date formatting module, removing the copy-pasted markup in SubmissionsWorklistPage.tsx:173-184/217/240, SubmissionPhotoEvidencePanel.tsx:86/97-102 and SubmissionAttachmentTiles.tsx:164-176/384.

Navigation: add a breadcrumb slot to AppShell (Submissions > D7-LA-5-PM12.3 > Photo evidence), give the worklist its own sidebar entry, and expose display names for created_by/actor/corrected_by on the submission, workflow-event and photo-map endpoints so 'User #id' disappears everywhere.
